pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
primary_text: "I need something close to the freeway and port." You're not wrong — location makes or breaks a warehouse. Truganina sits right off the Princes Freeway with direct access to the West Gate Tunnel and is just minutes from the Port of Melbourne. That's not "too far west" — that's strategically placed. Your freight moves faster, your staff commute stays easy, and your business operates from a brand-new warehouse you actually own. These off-the-plan units are purpose-built for small businesses who need logistics-friendly locations without CBD price tags. Don't let a postcode bias cost you the best move your business makes.
description: Direct Princes Freeway and West Gate Tunnel access from your front door
